instruction: Switch Thunderbird's theme to the Light theme.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled dark mode in Thunderbird by navigating hamburger menu -> Settings -> Add-ons and Themes -> Themes -> clicked Enable on Dark theme. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird menus, open Settings, browse Add-ons Manager, interact with UI buttons and checkboxes, scroll through settings pages
metadata.task_rationale: Agent navigated to Add-ons Manager > Themes and enabled Dark theme. Enabling Light theme instead is a direct variation using the exact same navigation path but selecting a different option.
metadata.explanation: Task requires switching to Light theme via Add-ons Manager > Themes. Evaluator checks prefs.js for extensions.activeThemeID matching 'light' via regex.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires switching to Light theme; evaluator checks extensions.activeThemeID in prefs.js for regex match 'light' - correctly identifies the Light theme
